title: Birth of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)
content: Muhammad (ﷺ) was born in Mecca in the Year of the Elephant (around 570 CE). He was an orphan; his father Abdullah died before his birth, and his mother Aminah died when he was six years old.

title: Marriage to Khadijah (RA)
content: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) married Khadijah bint Khuwailid when he was 25 years old and she was 40. Khadijah was a wealthy widow and businesswoman who had hired Muhammad (ﷺ) to lead her trade caravans before the marriage proposal.

title: First Divine Revelation
content: The first revelation came to Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) when he was 40 years old, while he was in the cave of Hira. The angel Jibril brought him the first verses of Surah Al-Alaq: 'Read in the name of your Lord who created.'

title: The Hijrah (Migration)
content: The Hijrah was the migration of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) and his followers from Mecca to Medina in 622 CE. This event marks the beginning of the Islamic Hijri calendar.

title: Death of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)
content: Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) passed away in Medina in the year 632 CE (11 AH) at the age of 63. He was buried in the house of his wife Aisha (RA).
